The '''Flank Cache''' is a special time-limited crate. It first appears during the [[Flank]] campaign, but also reappears later to give you another chance at purchasing.

Cost: 60 Volt Coins per open

Contents:
* [[Lobo]] x1
* [[Disruptor]] x1
* [[Cyclone]] x1
* [[Haze Humvee]] x2
* [[Wrecker]] x2
* [[Slammer]] x2
